category_title: Students exhibiting conflict avoidance in collaborative group work
scenario_title: Navigating group dynamics and uneven participation through public and private reflections
minimal_context: During a class session in an honors seminar, the tutor asks Joey to publicly share a metaphor describing his research team's progress with his peers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joey, please go ahead and publicly share the metaphor you wrote to describe your research team and your progress.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I described my team as an engine. This engine runs really well on three cylinders, but when the other two spark plug wires are attached, the engine acts almost as if it is supercharged.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What does that mean for your group's dynamics?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Up to this point the engine is running really well but there is so much more performance possible when all the spark plug wires contribute spark.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is an opportunity to encourage your teammates to become more engaged with the project. Do you have anything else to add about the deadlines or participation?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks uncomfortable) No, we are having relative success. I just want to encourage everyone to fully engage in the research process. Everything is fine.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Joey, please go ahead and publicly share the metaphor you wrote to describe your research team and your progress.

STUDENT: I described my team as an engine. This engine runs really well on three cylinders, but when the other two spark plug wires are attached, the engine acts almost as if it is supercharged.

TUTOR: What does that mean for your group's dynamics?

STUDENT: Up to this point the engine is running really well but there is so much more performance possible when all the spark plug wires contribute spark.

TUTOR: This is an opportunity to encourage your teammates to become more engaged with the project. Do you have anything else to add about the deadlines or participation?

STUDENT: (Looks uncomfortable) No, we are having relative success. I just want to encourage everyone to fully engage in the research process. Everything is fine.

task.content: Individually describe their research team and their progress using a metaphor and to publicly share this with their peers
task.learning_goal: To assess group dynamics and to explore more effective means to complete research tasks

context.environment: Class session in an honors seminar
context.materials: Weekly journals, online discussion boards, metaphor assignment
context.social_setting: Collaborative research team of five members, two of whom made fewer contributions to group meetings and occasionally missed research meetings

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When given an opportunity to publicly encourage teammates to become more engaged with the project
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Metaphorically painted a picture of relative success at the same time he was making a non-threatening appeal to his teammates to more fully engage in the research process, rather than sharing his actual frustration
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Frustrated with his groups' nonchalant attitude towards research deadlines; felt uncomfortable sharing his frustration because the expression of emotions in the classroom is not normative
related_quotes: This engine runs really well on three cylinders, but when the other two spark plug wires are attached, the engine acts almost as if it is supercharged ...Up to this point the engine is running really well but there is so much more performance possible when all the spark plug wires contribute spark ...

behavior_patterns.condition: When reflecting privately on the collaborative research team's productivity and participation
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Privately journaled his displeasure at the group dynamics and metaphorically described the team critically
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Felt he had a better understanding of the time demands given his previous research experience
related_quotes: A car with three out of the four wheels having loose lug nuts. Just because the wheels haven ’t fallen off yet doesn ’t mean that there isn ’t trouble ahead ...I think the passengers in the car with me forget that the roughest and most difficult part of the road is further in this area than they have experienced.
